text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God,
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: We sent Noah to his people: "You shall warn your people before a painful retribution afflicts them."
text_1989: We sent Noah to his people: “You shall warn your people before a painful retribution afflicts them.”
text_ref: We sent Noah to his people: "You shall warn your people before a painful retribution afflicts them."

text_1981: He said, “O my people, I come to you as a warner.
text_1989: He said, “O my people, I am a manifest warner to you.
text_ref: He said, "O my people, I am a manifest warner to you.

text_1981: “You shall worship God, work righteousness, and obey me.
text_1989: “To alert you that you shall worship GOD, reverence Him, and obey me.
text_ref: "To alert you that you shall worship GOD, reverence Him, and obey me.

text_1981: “God will then forgive your sins and respite you for a predetermined life span.
text_1989: “He will then forgive you your sins and respite you for a predetermined period. appointment can never be delayed, once it is due, if you only knew.”
text_ref: "He will then forgive you your sins and respite you for a predetermined period. Most assuredly, GOD's appointment can never be delayed, once it is due, if you only knew."

text_1981: He later said, “Lord, I have preached to my people night and day.
text_1989: He said, “My Lord, I have invited my people night and day.
text_ref: He said, "My Lord, I have invited my people night and day.

text_1981: “But my preaching only increased their fleeing.
text_1989: “But my invitation only increased their aversion.
text_ref: "But my invitation only increased their aversion.

text_1981: “Whenever I exhorted them to seek Your forgiveness, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, and insisted on their arrogance.
text_1989: “Whenever I invited them to be forgiven by You, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, insisted, and turned arrogant.
text_ref: "Whenever I invited them to be forgiven by You, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, insisted, and turned arrogant.

text_1981: “Then I preached to them loudly.
text_1989: “Then I invited them publicly.
text_ref: "Then I invited them publicly.

text_1981: “1 preached to them publicly, and I preached to them privately.
text_1989: “Then I proclaimed to them loudly, and I spoke to them privately.
text_ref: "Then I proclaimed to them loudly, and I spoke to them privately.

text_1981: “I said, ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord; He is forgiving.
text_1989: “I said, ‘Implore your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving. 2 2647 571 .
text_ref: "I said, 'Implore your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.

text_1981: ‘He will then shower you with generous rain.
text_1989: “ ‘He will then shower you generously with rain.
text_ref: "'He will then shower you generously with rain.

text_1981: ‘And supply you with money and children; and grant you gardens and rivers.’ "
text_1989: “ ‘And provide you with money and children, and orchards, and streams.’ ”
text_ref: " 'And provide you with money and children, and orchards, and streams.' "

text_1981: Why do you not wish to reverence God?
text_1989: Why should you not strive to reverence GOD?
text_ref: Why should you not strive to reverence GOD?

text_1981: He is the one who created you in stages.
text_1989: He is the One who created you in stages.
text_ref: He is the One who created you in stages.

text_1981: Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers? 16.
text_1989: Do you not realize that GOD created seven universes in layers?
text_ref: Do you not realize that GOD created seven universes in layers?

text_1981: He designed the moon therein to be a light, and placed the sun to be a lamp.
text_1989: He designed the moon therein to be a light, and placed the sun to be a lamp.
text_ref: He designed the moon therein to be a light, and placed the sun to be a lamp.

text_1981: God is the one who germinated you from the earth, just like plants.
text_1989: And GOD germinated you from the earth like nlants.
text_ref: And GOD germinated you from the earth like plants.

text_1981: Then He will return you to it, then resurrect you.
text_1989: Then He returns you into it, and He will surely bring you out.
text_ref: Then He returns you into it, and He will surely bring you out.

text_1981: God is the one who made the earth habitable for you.
text_1989: GOD made the earth habitable for you.
text_ref: GOD made the earth habitable for you.

text_1981: That you may establish roads therein. 21.
text_1989: That you may build roads therein.

text_1981: Noah said, "My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed those who were even more corrupted when blessed with money and children.
text_1989: Noah said, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed those who were even more corrupted when blessed with money and children.
text_ref: Noah said, "My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed those who were even more corrupted when blessed with money and children.

text_1981: “They schemed evil schemes.
text_1989: “They schemed terrible schemes.
text_ref: "They schemed terrible schemes.

text_1981: “They said, ‘Do not abandon your idols; do not abandon Wadd, or
text_1989: “They said, ‘Do not abandon your gods.
text_ref: "They said, 'Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, Suwaa', Yaghouth, Ya'ooq, and Nasr.'

text_1981: “They misguided many people. (My Lord,) do not increase the wicked except in straying.”
text_1989: “They misled many. Therefore, let the wicked plunge deeper into loss.”
text_ref: "They misled many. Therefore, let the wicked plunge deeper into loss."

text_1981: Because of their transgressions, they were drowned and destined for hell. They had none to help them against God.
text_1989: Because of their sins they were drowned and assigned to the hellfire. them from GOD.
text_ref: Because of their sins they were drowned and assigned to the hellfire. They found no helpers to protect them from GOD.

text_1981: Noah said, “Lord, do not leave on earth a single disbeliever.
text_1989: Noah also said, “My Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.
text_ref: Noah also said, "My Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.

text_1981: “If You leave any of them, they only mislead Your servants and give birth to evil disbelievers.
text_1989: “For if you let them, they will only mislead your servants and give birth to nothing but wicked disbelievers.
text_ref: "For if you let them, they will only mislead your servants and give birth to nothing but wicked disbelievers.

text_1981: “My Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and anyone who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women.
text_1989: “My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. But do not give the disbelievers anything but annihilation.” 5 2652 572
